segments.sensitive: One reviewer with sensitive, dry skin reports the product feels hydrating and smooth when used in the morning.
segments.dry: The same dry-skin reviewer pairs it with a retinal serum at night and describes good hydration and smoothness with no irritation mentioned.

concerns.aging: No reviewer specifically frames their use of this serum around aging or wrinkles.
concerns.dehydration: One reviewer with dry, sensitive skin reports her skin feels hydrated and smooth after use; another calls it part of the best hydration combo she has tried.
concerns.redness: No reviewer reports on redness specifically.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer reports the product peels her skin regardless of whether it is layered with other products or used alone, suggesting barrier irritation; no one else reports this issue.
concerns.spots: Reviewers mention brightening and evening out skin tone, but none specify dark spots or hyperpigmentation by name.
concerns.blemishes: One reviewer developed a cold sore after a single use, which she attributes to the L-arginine in the formula rather than acne breakouts; no other reviewer reports breakouts.
concerns.oiliness: One reviewer notes the serum is not sticky or too oily on her face in cold weather; no one reports it as too oily or too drying overall.
